newsitem.title: USA: Asdar says CasinoWorld terminates pact.
newsitem.headline: Asdar says CasinoWorld terminates pact.

text.p: Asdar Group Wednesday said CasinoWorld Holdings Ltd has terminated the non-binding letter of intent under which Asdar would have received a non-exclusive license to operate a virtual gaming casino over the Internet.

Asdar said CasinoWorld notified Asdar that its decision to cancel the proposed grant of the non-exclusive license was based on negative information concerning Asdar that was contained in an article published Aug. 18 in the San Diego Union Tribune.
Asdar said it believes that the newspaper article contained "libelous statements concerning Asdar and has referred the matter to counsel."

Asdar said it also believes that CasinoWorld's decision not to grant the non-exclusive gaming license will not have an adverse effect on the settlement of the class action litigation previously announced by Asdar on Aug. 12. However, as a result of the decision, Asdar said it does not have any ongoing business operations or any other plans or arrangements for the start of business operations in the foreseeable future.
